comments:
Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. [MPRU5QUC] records the name of this abbot as "'Jam dpal seng ge."
He received the name "'jam pa'i rdo rje" during a tantric initiation ([5632TFMN]: 312 and n. 11).
[5632TFMN]: 313 suggests he may have passed away in ca. 1227.
